english.title: Use vehicle not fitted with manufacturer plate - construction and use regulations

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Road Vehicles Construction and Use Regulations 1986

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) used on a road, namely **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..), a

(A)_[wheeled heavy motor car first used on or after 1st January 1968,]_
(B)_[motor car first used on or after 1st January 1968,]_
(C)_[bus first used on or after 1st April 1982,]_
(D)_[wheeled locomotive first used on or after 1st April 1973,]_
(E)_[motor tractor first used on or after 1st April 1973,]_

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 66(2) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) Section 66(1)(a) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 provides that the regulation does not apply to wheeled heavy motor cars or motor cars first used on or after 1st January 1968 if they are dual-purpose vehicles, agricultural motor vehicles, work trucks, pedestrian-controlled vehicles, passenger vehicles other than buses first used on or after 1st April 1982, and vehicles exempt from section 63(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 by virtue of regulation 14(6) of the Motor Vehicles (Approval) Regulations 1996.
(ii) Section 66(1)(b) of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 provides that the regulation does not apply to wheeled locomotives or motor tractors first used on or after 1st April 1973 if they are agricultural vehicles, industrial tractors, works trucks, engineering plants or pedestrian-controlled vehicles.
(iii) For the offence wording relating to wheeled trailers see H4891.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
